title: Good Old-Fashioned Lover Boy
lyrics:
[00:00.00]I can dim the lights and sing you songs full of sad things
[00:05.53]We can do the tango just for two
[00:10.53]I can serenade and gently play on your heart strings
[00:15.86]Be your Valentino, just for you
[00:20.92]Ooh, love, ooh, lover boy
[00:27.49]What you doin' tonight? (Hey, boy)
[00:30.79]Set my alarm, turn on my charm
[00:33.21]That's because I'm a good old-fashioned lover boy
[00:38.54]Ooh, let me feel your heartbeat (Grow faster, faster)
[00:45.15]Can you feel my love heat?
[00:47.75]Come on and sit on my hot seat of love
[00:50.39]And tell me how do you feel right after all?
[00:54.24]I'd like for you and I to go romancing
[00:58.61]Say the word, your wish is my command
[01:03.46]Ooh, love, ooh, lover boy
[01:09.94]What you doin' tonight? (Ooh, hey boy)
[01:13.19]Write my letter, feel much better
[01:15.76]And use my fancy patter on the telephone
[01:23.44]When I'm not with you
[01:25.99]Think of you always
[01:27.77](I miss those long, hot summer nights) I miss you
[01:33.54]When I'm not with you
[01:35.94]Think of me always
[01:38.53]Love you, love you
[01:43.57]Hey boy, where'd you get it from?
[01:46.26]Hey boy, where did you go?
[01:48.24]I learned my passion in the good old-fashioned school of lover boys
[02:14.48]Dining at the Ritz, we'll meet at nine, precisely (One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine o'clock)
[02:19.57]I will pay the bill, you taste the wine
[02:24.28]Driving back in style in my saloon will do quite nicely
[02:28.90]Just take me back to yours, that will be fine
[02:32.96]Come on and get it
[02:34.08]Ooh, love, ooh, lover boy (There he goes again, just like good old-fashioned lover boy)
[02:40.34]What you doin' tonight? (Ooh, hey boy)
[02:43.30]Everything's alright, just hold on tight
[02:45.81]That's because I'm a good old-fashioned lover boy
